requirements.text: Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience shipping production software.
Experience building across both frontend and backend systems; depth in one area with the ability and willingness to work across the stack.
Experience with modern web applications, APIs, services, databases, and data-intensive product workflows.
Strong product instincts and the ability to reason from a user or operational problem rather than from a narrowly defined technical task.
Ability to operate effectively in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment with a high degree of ownership.
Strong communication and technical judgment, including the ability to explain tradeoffs clearly.
A track record of taking meaningful projects from concept through launch and iteration.
Experience building operational tooling, fleet-management systems, logistics platforms, robotics or autonomous-vehicle products.
Experience with real-time or high-volume data systems.
Experience incorporating AI/ML capabilities or AI-enabled developer workflows into production products.
Startup or zero-to-one product engineering experience.

This role is based in our San Francisco office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.
